protected_manual.limits: Normal permission prompts, sandbox boundaries, deny rules, hooks and managed policy remain in force.

protected_auto.limits: Auto mode is surface/account/model dependent. Unknown support blocks activation and never falls through to Full Access.

full_access.limits: Highest-risk request. Deny rules, hooks, managed policy, OS limits and external authorization can still block actions.

verification: Confirm loaded project settings, effective effort/model controls, skill discovery, permission behavior and the actual sandbox coverage for this OS and surface. Report unknown/unsupported when not exposed.
